import numpy as np, torch, model
net=model.load(); neg=model.negatives()
idx=[i for i,u in enumerate(neg['uid']) if u in (17,35,37,53)]
torch.manual_seed(3)
N=3000; xi=torch.randn(N,2); xin=np.asarray(xi)
T=[]
for i in idx:
    c=float(neg['c'][i]); a=np.asarray(model.decode(net,xi,torch.full((N,),c)))
    inb=np.asarray(model.in_basin(i,a)).astype(bool)
    ang=np.arctan2(a[:,1],a[:,0])
    cb=np.median(a[inb],0); thb=np.arctan2(cb[1],cb[0])
    nang=np.arctan2(xin[:,1],xin[:,0]); nb=np.angle(np.mean(np.exp(1j*nang[inb])))
    x0=np.asarray(neg['xi'][i]); n0=np.arctan2(x0[1],x0[0])
    side=np.sign(np.angle(np.exp(1j*(n0-nb))))
    # neighbour mode: samples with action angle offset in side direction, between 25 and 65 deg
    off=np.degrees(np.angle(np.exp(1j*(ang-thb))))
    # determine whether noise angle increasing maps to action angle increasing
    corr=np.sign(np.corrcoef(np.unwrap(nang[inb]-nb),np.angle(np.exp(1j*(ang[inb]-thb))))[0,1])
    s=side*corr
    sel=(~inb)&(s*off>20)&(s*off<70)
    cen=np.median(a[sel],0)
    print(neg['uid'][i],round(c,3),'basin ctr',np.round(cb,2),'noise side',side,'corr',corr,'nbr ctr',np.round(cen,2),'n',sel.sum(),'spread',np.round(a[sel].std(0),2))
    T.append(cen)
np.save('rescue_nbr.npy',np.array(T,dtype=np.float32)); print(np.array(T))
